messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 1: Helios BioSystems (enterprise, renewal in ~9w) asked for a 90m workshop on Private deployment + KMS/HSM integration. They want hands-on sections and a short billing/consumption review. Can we schedule something that hits CET/APAC overlap?
Ruben Soto: I can lead the Private deployment walkthrough and HSM integration. Prefer 13:30-15:00 UTC to hit late CET and early APAC.
Leah Kim: Ill cover billing/consumption + cost optimisation (batching & quant). Agendawise I think 15m intro, 30m deployment walkthrough, 25m hands-on lab, 15m billing + 5m feedback. That fits 90m if we include buffer.
Arun Desai: For hands-on lab we need ephemeral creds and a sanitized config. Can CS request a sanitized VM image or container snapshot? Also suggest a short pre-survey to capture priority areas (KMS, network, compliance).
Maya Patel: Good call. I'll request sanitized assets and attendee list. Also adding a renewal-specific question to the pre-survey: "post-workshop confidence (1-5)" and "top outstanding compliance blocker".
Spark (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Helios Private + KMS Workshop  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/helios-private-kms (will update after poll).
Ruben Soto: Time poll: `poll: ["13:30-15:00 UTC", "14:30-16:00 UTC"]` — second slot conflicts with internal infra review. Please vote; closing in 3h.
Leah Kim: Also need two breakout hosts for the lab (networking / KMS). Ruben + me? I can pair with someone from compliance if needed.
Arun Desai: I'll prepare a short rollback checklist and a safe demo harness: `scripts/private-deploy-demo.sh` with clear checkpoints. Please ask Helios to provide a read-only sanitized config by Tue.
Maya Patel: Feedback capture link (renewal signal): https://forms.gle/redwood-helios-feedback  questions: "most valuable segment", "remaining showstopper?", "interest in dedicated follow-up (yes/no)". We'll flag any "showstopper" as high renewal risk.
Spark (calendar-bot): Poll closed  majority selected `13:30-15:00 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent. Recording enabled; channel created: #helios-private-kms-workshop.
Ruben Soto: I'll upload the demo deck and runner script by Mon COB and mock creds for hosts.
Leah Kim: Shared drive created: https://drive.redwood.example/helios-private-kms (agenda, prework, runbook). I'll post billing slides and a 1-pager cost checklist.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. I'll follow up with Helios for sanitized snapshot and attendee emails. Moving follow-ups into #helios-private-kms-workshop and closing this scheduling thread.
